scripts.dev: npm run kill-ports && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.kill-ports: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:5001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && pip3 install -r requirements.txt -q 2>/dev/null; python3 run.py
